name: My Elf Family
source:
The main character One, with some serious scars and wears an iron helmet, just falls out of the sky right on top of a hot elf milf.

The story takes place in a little town called Foothill, which is right next to a massive volcano and the entrance to a dungeon.

[From [url=https://solid-camera.itch.io/my-elf-family]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角One，带着严重的伤疤，戴着铁盔，从天而降，正好压在一个火辣的精灵熟女身上。

故事发生在一个叫山麓的小镇，毗邻一座巨大的火山和地牢的入口。

[来自[url=https://solid-camera.itch.io/my-elf-family]itch.io[/url]]
